name: AIENG Forward-Port Copy Pass

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/aieng-forward-port-copy-20260907
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/aieng-forward-port-copy.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  forward-port:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout approved reconciliation baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: 09e98c1689bc94541d52d9aa1e8d7933573dd8f5

      - name: Configure Git identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "Monad EOS Automation"
          git config user.email "eos-automation@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch legacy source branch
        run: git fetch origin eosp/ai-driven-engineering-operating-model

      - name: Copy branch-only authoritative artifacts
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source_ref="origin/eosp/ai-driven-engineering-operating-model"
          files=(
            architecture/decisions/ADR-0008-ai-driven-engineering-as-default-eos-operating-model.md
            engineering/lifecycle/EOS-AI-0001-ai-driven-engineering-operating-model.md
            engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md
            engineering/maintenance/MNT-0004.md
            engineering/maintenance/MNT-0005.md
            engineering/maintenance/MNT-0006.md
            engineering/reviews/AIENG-NORMATIVE-TRACEABILITY-AND-CONFORMANCE-REVIEW.md
            engineering/reviews/DECISION-0003-2026-09-05-adr-0008-acceptance.md
            engineering/reviews/DECISION-0004-2026-09-05-eos-ai-0001-acceptance.md
            engineering/reviews/DECISION-0005-2026-09-05-aieng-normative-baseline-approval.md
            engineering/reviews/DECISION-0006-2026-09-05-eos-hardening-maintenance-implementation-approval.md
            engineering/reviews/DECISION-0007-2026-09-05-mnt-0006-closure-approval.md
            engineering/reviews/DECISION-0008-2026-09-05-mnt-0005-closure-approval.md
            engineering/reviews/DECISION-0009-2026-09-05-mnt-0003-implementation-approval.md
            engineering/reviews/DECISION-0010-2026-09-07-mnt-0003-closure-approval.md
            engineering/reviews/EOS-AI-0001-OPERATING-MODEL-REVIEW.md
            engineering/reviews/MNT-0003-EVENT-LEDGER-MERGE-SAFETY-VERIFICATION.md
            engineering/reviews/MNT-0003-REVIEW.md
            engineering/reviews/MNT-0005-IDENTITY-RESOLUTION-VERIFICATION.md
            engineering/reviews/MNT-0005-REVIEW.md
            engineering/reviews/MNT-0006-CANONICAL-TRANSACTION-ATOMICITY-VERIFICATION.md
            engineering/reviews/MNT-0006-REVIEW.md
            specifications/functional/FUN-AIENG-0001-adaptive-engineering-workflow.md
            specifications/interfaces/IFC-AIENG-0001-engineering-agent-contract.md
            specifications/security/SEC-AIENG-0001-autonomy-authority-and-approval-gates.md
            tools/eos/identity_families.py
            tools/eos/test_identifier_families.py
          )
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            if [ -e "$file" ]; then
              echo "refusing to overwrite existing main-line file: $file" >&2
              exit 31
            fi
            mkdir -p "$(dirname "$file")"
            git show "$source_ref:$file" > "$file"
          done

      - name: Validate bounded copy
        run: |
          git diff --check
          python3 tools/eos/test_identifier_families.py
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import subprocess
          prohibited_prefixes = (
              '.eos/evidence/',
              'engineering/evidence/',
              'machine/',
          )
          prohibited_exact = {
              '.eos/artifacts.tsv',
              '.eos/events.jsonl',
              '.eos/evidence.tsv',
              '.eos/state/current.json',
              '.eos/state/projections.json',
              '.eos/trace-edges.tsv',
          }
          changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--short'], text=True).splitlines()
          paths = [line[3:] for line in changed if len(line) >= 4]
          bad = sorted(
              path for path in paths
              if path in prohibited_exact or any(path.startswith(prefix) for prefix in prohibited_prefixes)
          )
          if bad:
              raise SystemExit('prohibited generated/evidence import: ' + ', '.join(bad))
          print(f'bounded authoritative copy: PASS ({len(paths)} paths)')
          PY

      - name: Commit authoritative forward-port
        run: |
          git add \
            architecture/decisions/ADR-0008-ai-driven-engineering-as-default-eos-operating-model.md \
            engineering/lifecycle/EOS-AI-0001-ai-driven-engineering-operating-model.md \
            engineering/maintenance/MNT-0003.md \
            engineering/maintenance/MNT-0004.md \
            engineering/maintenance/MNT-0005.md \
            engineering/maintenance/MNT-0006.md \
            engineering/reviews \
            specifications/functional/FUN-AIENG-0001-adaptive-engineering-workflow.md \
            specifications/interfaces/IFC-AIENG-0001-engineering-agent-contract.md \
            specifications/security/SEC-AIENG-0001-autonomy-authority-and-approval-gates.md \
            tools/eos/identity_families.py \
            tools/eos/test_identifier_families.py
          git diff --cached --check
          git commit -m "docs(eos): forward-port AIENG normative authority"

      - name: Publish immutable copy result
        run: git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/automation/aieng-forward-port-copy-result-20260907
